source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 7 June 1958, p. 8 ("Notice of result of elections: Magherafelt Rural District Council, 1958 (Returning Officer's notice)")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Mid-Ulster Mail 7 Jun 1958 p8 (page image read): no poll in any division; the person entered in column 6 duly elected.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 5 June 1958. All candidates were returned unopposed; new members were William G. Ovenden (Bellaghy), H. P. Kelly (Rocktown) and P. Trolan (Ballinascreten) (Derry Journal, 23 May 1958, p. 7). The report does not map the members to divisions. All 26 divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 7 June 1958, p. 8): no poll anywhere; in Clady, with no nomination, the retiring member Michael Henry was deemed re-elected (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
